source.text: The fuel interior keeps the energy the pulse deposits (adiabatic, the window is 60 ms against a 17 s diffusion time over the radius): T = T0 + E s / c = 600 K.
source.check: Second method: oracles/point-kinetics-reference.py (RK4 with bisection and quadrature, run in the feed-solver distro) agrees with the same formulas on the Nordheim-Fuchs case (oracles/point-kinetics-reference.json); FEED's generator tests (tests/pointKinetics.test.ts) check the same closed forms; through the solver, tests/pointKineticsSolver.test.ts.

coverage.domain: synthetic pin, generated pulse from point kinetics (a 1.5 % dk/k step, prompt neutrons only, constant feedback -1e-4 dk/k/K), constant heat capacity, 60 ms window
